title: Chola — The Kaveri Kingdom of Fertile Fields, Ancient Cities and the Eastern Sea
description: The Bhishma Parva contains one of the Mahabharata's extraordinary surveys of Bharatavarsha. After describing northern, eastern and central regions, the text turns towards the south and names numerous peoples including the Dravidas, Keralas, Mushikas, Vanavashikas, Karanatakas, Mahishakas, Kuntalas and Cholas. The placement leaves little doubt that the Cholas belonged to the recognised political geography of southern India.
